- Some hesitation or minimal engagement
- Not immediately opening up about the core shame
- Maybe acknowledging the situation in a somewhat detached way
- Perhaps framing it as "my mother made me come" to reduce personal agency/responsibility
- Or a somewhat resigned acknowledgment
